reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate with Kroger
reauth_confirm.description: Kroger refresh tokens expire after six months. Select **Submit** to sign in again.

store.title: Choose your store
store.description: Your ZIP code is used once, to list nearby stores. The chain filter narrows the list to one banner.

data_description.chain: For example KINGSOOPERS, KROGER, FRED MEYER or RALPHS.

data_description.modality: Whether items are added for pickup or delivery by default.

manual_store.title: Enter your store ID
manual_store.description: No stores came back for that ZIP code and chain. You can enter the eight-character store ID by hand instead.

error.no_locations: No stores were found for that ZIP code and chain.

abort.oauth2_missing_configuration: The component is not configured. Please follow the documentation.
abort.oauth2_no_url_available: No URL available. For information about this error, [check the help section]({docs_url})

data_description.location_id: The eight-character store ID used to price and stock-check searches.

application_credentials.description: Create an application in the [Kroger developer console]({developer_console_url}) with the redirect URI `{redirect_url}` and the scopes `cart.basic:write`, `product.compact` and `profile.compact`, then paste its client ID and secret here.

add_to_cart.name: Add to cart
add_to_cart.description: Adds one or more items to the cart of the signed-in Kroger account. The item lands in the cart for whichever store that account currently has selected.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which Kroger account to use. Only needed when more than one is set up.

upc.name: UPC
upc.description: One 13-digit product ID, or a list of them. Use the Search products action to find them.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: How many of each item to add.

modality.name: Modality
modality.description: Pickup or delivery. Defaults to the value chosen during setup.

search_products.name: Search products
search_products.description: Searches the Kroger catalogue and returns matching products with their UPCs, prices and stock levels.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which Kroger account to use. Only needed when more than one is set up.

term.name: Search term
term.description: A fuzzy search term, at least three characters and at most eight words.

brand.name: Brand
brand.description: Restrict results to one brand. Case-sensitive.

location_id.name: Store ID
location_id.description: Overrides the configured store. Prices, stock levels and aisles are relative to this store.

fulfillment.name: Fulfillment
fulfillment.description: Restrict results to products available these ways.

auth_failed.message: Kroger rejected the credentials. The refresh token may have expired; reauthenticate the integration.

rate_limited.message: Kroger's daily call limit has been reached. The cart allowance is 5,000 calls per day and the product allowance is 10,000.

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach the Kroger API.

entry_not_found.message: No loaded Kroger account with ID {entry_id}.

no_entries.message: No Kroger account is set up and loaded.

multiple_entries.message: More than one Kroger account is set up. Specify which one with the Account field.

search_needs_term.message: A search needs either a search term or a brand.
